problems: Repair pass: kingdom-of-sweden now cites 27 pages against a budget of 9 (17 opened for the reviewer's fixes); norway-denmark cites 3 against 2.

Orchestrator decision still needed: swedish-empire merge or pause for 1612-1904 (Sweden infobox lists 'Swedish Empire: 1611-1721' as an era of the same state); until then Stolbovo 1617, Altmark 1629, Bromsebro 1645, Roskilde 1658, Nystad 1721, 1743 and the 1809-9 loss of Finland have no Swedish-side event.

Disagreement with the reviewer: the 1502 shape is ended at 1519, not 1520, because kalmar-union's 1520 keyframe already draws the realm (gain 1520-11) and every other handover lets the new holder draw from the event year.
Disagreement with the reviewer's remedy: no ruler strip, because the List of Swedish monarchs page has durations only.

Ingria and Kexholm were not lost together in 1590: Ingria in February 1590 (Russo-Swedish War page), Kexholm on 18 May 1595 (Treaty of Teusina page); the History of Sweden page's 'in 1590, Sweden had to cede Ingria and Kexholm' is right for Ingria only. Narva is dated 1581 (Livonian War page), not 1583.
Sweden's 1564-1570 occupation of Jamtland and Herjedalen mirrors denmark-norway's contest of 1563-1570-12 (types differ). The page says Trondelag was repelled; denmark-norway reads it the same way.

Cross-dossier: teutonic-order's 1398 Gotland gain should name the Danish crown, not kingdom-of-sweden; old-kingdom-of-norway and norway-denmark both draw Norway 1042-1047; kalmar-union's contest over Norway 1449-1450 (counterpart kingdom-of-sweden) has no Swedish mirror because Norway was not Swedish land.
The 1905 'loss of Norway' was dropped (Norway never gained here): kingdom-of-norway (eu-20) should not expect a mirror from kingdom-of-sweden.
Greenland is subtracted from the Sweden 1333, 1344, 1360 and 1361 corrections with a box round it as well as the country outline; the country outline alone left 6 to 14 cells inside Sweden.
